name: Economy log: Bazaar Tokens earned are summed into one tokens_earned row per source at each save
contract: With the economy log on, every Bazaar Token (975001) a character earns adds to the one waiting tokens_earned row of its source (1 kill, 2 quest, 3 dungeon boss, 4 raid boss, 5 cache, 6 exchange, 7 other); the row is written at the character's next save.

A quest turn-in stores its reward items, saves the character and then pays the Ethereal Bazaar's random quest bonus (Player::RewardQuest: reward items, SaveToDB, OnPlayerCompleteQuest), so the reward tokens are written by the turn-in's own save and the bonus waits for the next one.

A level-60 Human turns in Scarlet Sweep: Magic and Might (18034, 50 tokens) and then Duel! (80651, 40 tokens): the turn-in's own save writes exactly 50 quest tokens and each bonus is written by a later save when it is not zero, so the 50 is one row of its own; with Duel!'s 40 that makes two to four quest rows, and no row for any other source.
